lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines visible on the lateral torso; spacing is wider in the anterior/shoulder region (lines 1-3) and becomes progressively more compressed and high-density in the mid-to-posterior torso (lines 4-10).
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One Y-shaped bifurcation is visible in the posterior-mid torso where two line segments merge into a single terminus at the dorsal ridge; one inverted bifurcation occurs in the anterior-mid torso where a single line splits into two descending segments.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first anterior line and the two most posterior lines are abbreviated, terminating before crossing the ventral-lateral midline; mid-torso lines 5 and 6 show significant pixel-level thinning and brief interruption at the mid-flank.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: High-contrast grouping of approximately 6 white spots located on the lower posterior haunch with a dense cluster formation immediately above the hock transition.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three distinct spots are aligned in a semi-linear horizontal pattern across the mid-thigh, parallel to the ground plane.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white spot located on the lower cheek/mandible region; distinct white transverse band across the bridge of the muzzle; white high-contrast patches visible on the interior of the forelegs and the posterior surface of the hind limbs.
